run_mldoc_embeddings: run the mldoc script to calculate LASER sentence embeddings for the MLDoc corpus across train, dev, and test splits
run_encodefile: run EncodeFile to encode BPE-tokenized sentences into LASER embeddings using a loaded SentenceEncoder
run_token: run Token to tokenize a text file with language-specific processing, romanization, and lowercasing
run_bpefastapply: run BPEfastApply to apply Byte Pair Encoding subword tokenization to split text files using BPE codes
run_splitlines: run SplitLines to split tokenized text into individual lines and extract sentence IDs
